answer: The grove lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the comet is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the vertex of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
